items.content: ## 工具介绍 KnowlifyAI是一款收费的转录工具，可以批量将视频和音频转成文本，并利用AI大模型对文字内容进行格式优化，错误修复，段落结构调整，等等，使你得到结构和质量良好的文本，也方便后续喂到AI知识库中进行智能问答。 - [使用方法 - 智慧谷](https://wisdom-valley.net/guide/knowlify-ai/index.html) - [产品下载 - 智慧谷](https://wisdom-valley.net/get/index.html)，产品公测期间`0.01`元/每月。 ## 适用场景 1. 当你从互联网上购买了几个TB的课程，你想要用快速学习，快速搜索，或者想用AI进行问答，各网盘和在线知识库服务产品都不提供你如此大的批量的处理。 2. 当你从哔哩哔哩或者YouTube上看到很有用的视频，但是时长都很大，你想要把他们保存下载，然后用AI进行问答，除了NoteBookLM可以直接提炼YouTube上的视频的摘要，你目前还没什么特别好的办法。 3. 如果你是一个持续的学习者，你经常会从各个渠道找到一些视频或者音频的资料并保存到本地，你发现每次都要转录，很是麻烦，那么KnowlifyAI也可以帮你解决这个麻烦。 ## 核心价值 - 能够批量转录音视频，没有个数和时长的限制，还可以自动监控目录出现的新文件，一旦发现就会自动转录。 - 支持NVIDIA显卡进行加速，能够比CPU转录提升10倍以上的效率。 - LLM大模型可以对转录的文本进行各种优化，减少文章的错误和优化格式。 - 支持 Windows、Linux、macOS 跨平台。

items.title: 【工具自荐】AI Stock Monitor：给做卖 Put、Covered Call 稳健风格的散户用的持仓管理工具
items.author: yonayinhong-art
items.summary: 老师好， 推荐一个我自己做的投资工具： 背景说一下 我自己做期权卖方策略（主要是 Wheel，偶尔加点 LEAPS），做了一段时间发现一个头疼的事：持仓一多，风险就变得很难一眼看清楚——到期日快到了吗？有没有财报要撞上了？某只标的仓位是不是集中得有点过？ 每次手动去核查，又烦又容易漏。所以就自己动手做了这个工具。 主要能干什么 账户体检：把券商持仓截图上传，AI 自动识别期权策略（Iron Condor、Covered Call 这些），然后跑 19 条规则扫描——保证金、指派风险、集中度、压力测试都覆盖到，红黄绿分级，有问题的直接给操作建议。 机会雷达：围绕你自己设的自选股和价格目标，每天自动扫描 Sell Put 时机、IV 低位、MA200 信号等，不是把全市场机会都推给你，只看你关注的那些。 风险信号：财报前提前预警历史跳空幅度、IV 异动捕捉、跌破 MA200 提醒——想在风险暴露之前就知道，不是事后复盘。 数据面板：输入任意标的，查 IV/HV 历史图、IV Rank 分位、P/E·P/B 估值历史、近 24 小时热点事件。 AI 助手：不是通用的那种，接入了你自己的持仓和信号，问"这个 Put 要不要 Roll"能给你具体的选项对比，而不是教科书式的废话。 适合谁用 做 Wheel、卖 Put 收租、或者就是想稳稳管好一个中等规模组合的人。不是给做高频或者纯技术分析的朋友准备的。 目前注册免费体验，已经有一百多个用户在用了，欢迎有兴趣的朋友试试，也欢迎提意见。

items.title: 【工具自荐】 OtterHub：基于 Cloudflare KV + Telegram Bot API 的免费私人云盘方案
items.author: DJChanahCJD
items.summary: 🔗 项目地址：
items.content: > 🔗 项目地址：https://github.com/DJChanahCJD/OtterHub ## 🎯 项目定位 基于 **Cloudflare KV + Telegram Bot API** 的轻量级私人云盘，专注于个人文件存储场景，提供**免费、稳定、易维护**的解决方案。 > **体验站点**：[OtterHub Demo](https://otterhub-demo.pages.dev/) > 账号：`OtterHub` | 密码：`123456`（演示站仅支持≤20MB文件，1小时自动清理） ## ✨ 核心亮点 ### 💎 大文件支持 - **分片上传**：突破 Telegram 20MB 限制，已实测稳定上传 100MB，理论支持至 1GB - **断点续传**：HTTP Range 支持，视频/音频按需加载 - **流式处理**：边拉取边返回，内存占用低 ### 🚀 完善的文件管理 - **多格式支持**：图片/音频/视频/文档，URL 直接预览 - **智能分类**：KV Key 按类型前缀（`img:` `audio:` `video:` `doc:`），查询效率高 - **回收站**：30天自动清理，支持恢复与永久删除 - **批量操作**：下载/删除/重命名，搜索/收藏/标签/排序 - **AI图片分析**：上传自动生成描述，便于检索（需配置 Workers AI） ### 🔒 安全与私密 - **密码登录**：JWT + Cookie 认证 - **NSFW 检测**：客户端智能识别，安全模式自动遮罩 - **私人场景**：不支持公共上传，专注个人使用 ### ⚡ 性能优化 - **缓存策略**：非 Range 走 Cloudflare Cache，Range 请求直出 - **流量控制**：省流模式/无图模式，≥5MB 图片可选择不加载 - **存储容量**：KV 单文件 <500 字节，理论存储 ≥200 万个文件 ## 🛠 技术特色 ### 架构设计 - **前后端分离**：Next.js 前端 + Hono 后端（Cloudflare Pages Functions） - **TypeScript 全栈**：类型安全，重构成本低 - **Monorepo 结构**：前后端独立开发，共享类型定义 ### 开发体验 - **本地 R2 模拟**：无需 Telegram Token 即可调试 - **一键启动**：`npm run dev` 同时启动前后端 - **自动化测试**：`npm run ci-test` 快速验证上传下载功能 ## 📊 技术栈 - **前端**：Next.js + TypeScript + Zustand - **后端**：Hono + Cloudflare Workers - **存储**：Cloudflare KV + Telegram Bot API - **AI**：Workers AI（可选） --- **技术灵感**：架构参考 [Telegraph-Image](https://github.com/cf-pages/Telegraph-Image)，分片设计参考 [CloudFlare-ImgBed](https://github.com/MarSeventh/CloudFlare-ImgBed) 欢迎体验试用、提出建议或参与贡献！⭐️

items.content:
项目地址：https://github.com/wyh0626/resume-optimizer

**解决什么问题**

求职者写简历最常见的毛病是"写了做过什么，没写做成了什么"。这个 Skill 让 AI 扮演一个严格的简历审计官，用"所以呢？"拷问法逐条审查你的简历，把职责描述改写成有说服力的成就描述，并根据目标岗位 JD 定向优化。

**核心功能**

* 五步深度审计：30秒初筛定论 → 地毯式逐项审查 → 战略修改蓝图 → 完整改写稿输出 → 行动清单
* 影响力叙事改写：用 STAR/CAR 法则和决策-权衡模型，把"负责XX系统"变成"解决了XX问题，带来XX结果"
* JD 匹配分析：根据目标岗位调整关键词、项目重点和职业叙事线
* 风险识别：自动识别外包经历包装、玩具项目充数、量化缺失、技术表述失真等常见雷区
* 一页简历压缩：两页以上简历可自动压缩为一页精华版

**安装**

```bash
# Claude Code
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
git clone https://github.com/wyh0626/resume-optimizer.git ~/.claude/skills/resume-optimizer

# Codex
mkdir -p ~/.codex/skills
git clone https://github.com/wyh0626/resume-optimizer.git ~/.codex/skills/resume-optimizer
```

**适用场景**

社招/校招简历优化、投递前按 JD 定制、面试前自查漏洞、外包/转岗/空窗期叙事修复。开箱即用。

items.summary: 官网地址： SpokenType —— 让沟通回归自然，让输入触手可及。 全场景 AI 智能语音协作专家 —— 现已开启公测 【核心功能：实时翻译与高效输入】 即时同传级翻译： 支持母语实时转译，译文随语而至，实现无延迟、无停顿的地道表达。 全场景跨语言输入： 无论是邮件撰写、即时通讯还是文档编辑，只需母语表达，即可实现目标语言的精准输出。 极速语音转文字： 支持本地与云端双模驱动。本地响应极速，云端智能优化；效率较键盘提升 4 倍，录入速度达每分钟 220 字。 智能口语优化： 内置自动结构化算法与口语过滤技术，自动移除“嗯”、“啊”等冗余词汇，智能添加标点并进行分段，让口语瞬间蜕变为高质量文章。 【智能交互：深度上下文理解】 AI 读屏与智能回复： 深度融合屏幕内容与个人记忆，精准捕捉上下文语义，仅需一句话即可生成符合个人习惯的得体回复。 一键意图驱动编辑： 支持选中文字后通过语音下达指令。无论是精简、扩写、改变语气，还是生成创意回复，AI 均能精准理解并即刻执行。 交互式文本问答： 选中任何网页或文档内容，即可通过语音进行摘要提取、深度解释或翻译，实现无缝的工作流体验。 【个性化定制：精准与专业】 智能场景适配： 根据应用环境自动切换语调——邮件场景专业严谨，聊天场景轻松自然，文档场景逻辑清晰。 个性化词典： 深度学习并记忆用户的专属术语、特定名称与表达习惯，确保在各类应用中均能实现极高的识别准确率。 多语言无缝切换： 支持 50+ 种语言，具备强大的语言自动检测能力，支持多语言混说，沟通无国界。 【操作便捷】 快捷键触发： 支持短按快捷键快速启动语音输入，随叫随用。

items.title: Velu
items.summary: Professional Presentation Done Right
items.content: Meet Velu! The professional information platform built to handle your professional presence from end to end. Capture and maintain your professional information once, and Velu will organise, present, and help you share it. Build a living Professional Record with your experience, skills, projects, education, publications, qualifications, recognition, references, and more, all in one place and ready to use wherever it matters.

items.title: Cenote
items.summary: AI Sales Agents for Abandoned Checkouts
items.content: Cenote deploys AI sales reps that reach out to abandoned checkouts, churned patients, and other high-intent leads in real time, answering questions and converting them into customers. Most brands can’t meaningfully engage every visitor who shows intent. Cenote changes that by texting or calling every high-intent drop-off automatically, helping D2C brands recover revenue they’ve already paid for.

items.title: MicroPlastics
items.summary: Research-backed microplastics scanner for food
items.content: MicroPlastics helps you scan food and beverages to estimate microplastics exposure based on packaging material, wear, and usage context like heat or reuse. Every score is backed by peer-reviewed research and includes citations, so users get more than a vague “healthy” label. Track exposure over time, compare products, and make better everyday choices. In partnership with PlasticOrg Group in Bay Area and associated research.

items.title: Millennium Mixtape
items.summary: How well do you know the 2000s?
items.content: Millennium Mixtape is a daily game to take you back to the 2000s. Playing clips of the songs that defined the decade and giving you points to prove that you remember the "oldies."

items.title: Reminni APK
items.summary: Enhance blurry photos instantly with AI-powered editing
items.content: Remini AI Photo Enhancer is a mobile-focused tool designed to improve image quality using AI. It helps restore old photos, sharpen blurry images, and enhance facial details with minimal effort. Whether you're working with old memories or low-resolution pictures, the tool focuses on making images clearer and more usable without complex editing skills. It’s especially useful for quick fixes when you don’t want to spend time on manual photo editing.

items.title: Replica
items.summary: The social interface for a tokenized world
items.content: Stop staring at complex dashboards. Replica is the interface for a tokenized world. Most brokers are "black boxes." We fixed that by combining copy-trading with full on-chain custody. Key Features: - Expert Portfolios: Follow strategies with proven track records. - One-Click Copy: Invest in seconds, not hours. - Full Ownership: Your assets stay in your account. No middlemen. - Simulate Flow: Test any strategy before committing capital. Transparent, dynamic exposure.

items.title: PostMind
items.summary: Your AI writing assistant for X — posts, threads & replies
items.content: Stop staring at a blank screen. PostMind generates ready-to-post content for X in seconds. Write posts, build threads, craft replies, and rewrite drafts — all in your voice. Set your style, add custom instructions, and post directly to X. Free to start.

items.title: CGPA Calculator
items.summary: Stop guessing your GPA calculate it in seconds
items.content: Unlike complex CGPA tools, this calculator is built for simplicity and speed. No confusing formulas or unnecessary steps just enter your grades and get instant, accurate results. It works across different grading systems and devices, making it accessible for students everywhere. Fast, clean, and 100% free to use.

items.title: Inko
items.summary: Send your family an emoji every day. Know when they don't.
items.content: Inko is a free daily emoji check-in app for families. Send up to three emojis a day, build streaks, and know when someone misses. A warmer alternative to Demumu.

items.title: LastVault
items.summary: Dead man's switch for your cold wallet assets
items.content: Dead man's switch for your crypto cold wallet. Set it up once: add your heir's email, record where your seed phrase is stored, then check in every 30 days. Miss the window? There's a 7-day grace period. Still no response — the inheritance email sends automatically with a full cold wallet recovery guide attached. No seed phrases ever stored on our servers. One-time payment, no subscription — if you're gone, who's going to renew it?

items.title: G.I.N.A
items.summary: La méditation sur mesure. Simplement unique. Juste pour vous
items.content: Il y a des milliers d'apps de méditation. Elles ont toutes le même problème : elles ne vous connaissent pas. Une séance sur mesure, ça se faisait en cabinet. Pas à 23h dans son lit. Pas dans le train avant un entretien. G.I.N.A change ça. G.I.N.A génère une séance unique, adaptée à votre humeur du moment. Privée. Intime. Que vous serez le seul, la seule, à avoir entendue. Pas d'abonnement. Pas de programme. Juste vous.

items.title: Govplane
items.summary: Control your app at runtime — no redeploys, no delays.
items.content: Govplane lets you control how your application behaves — securely, no redeploys, instantly. Define policies to: • Allow or deny actions • Apply rate limits • Trigger kill switches • Adapt behavior in real time All managed from a centralized and secure control plane. Policies are compiled into a signed bundle and evaluated locally, ensuring: • Zero latency • Deterministic results • Secure execution Built for teams that need control without complexity. Free plan available or 45-day trial.

items.title: ChatBody
items.summary: An AI health tracker you use through chat
items.content: Chat with your body. Log meals, workouts, and weight through conversation. Health tracking that feels as simple as sending a message.

items.title: GhostDesk
items.summary: Stay in flow. Your AI handles the rest.
items.content: GhostDesk 2.0 is an invisible Windows AI overlay that is invisible to any screen recording software or proctoring software. Get instant AI answers (DeepSeek V3 for reasoning, voice I/O, OCR) in 3 seconds without breaking focus. Free 3-day trial with 10 queries/day. Pay only $5/24hr, $9.99/mo globally—cheaper than Cluely, LockedIn AI, or InterviewCoder. Private by default.

items.title: Smart Resume
items.summary: Turn your CV into interviews with AI + ATS insights
items.content: Smart Resume shows you why your CV gets rejected and helps you fix it. Most resume tools just generate documents. Smart Resume analyses your CV against real job descriptions, identifies missing keywords, weak sections and positioning issues, and gives clear, actionable fixes. It also lets you practice interviews with AI, generate tailored CVs and cover letters, and track your job search with a visual pipeline so you can see where you’re losing opportunities.

items.title: BotPapa
items.summary: Build & monetize Telegram Mini Apps without code
items.content: BotPapa is a no-code builder for Telegram Mini Apps inside Telegram Build and launch apps — from shops to content platforms — without code Built specifically for Telegram, so everything works natively: auth, payments (Telegram Stars), and user flows With BotPapa you can: • Build apps with a visual editor • Create Shops • Accept payments via Telegram Stars • Gate content with subscriptions Perfect for founders who want to test ideas fast in Telegram

items.title: RemoveFrom.Video
items.summary: Remove watermark, text, subtitles and objects from video
items.content: Remove watermark, text, subtitles and unwanted objects from video online with AI. Clean TikTok, YouTube and social media videos without complex editing software.

items.title: LedgerIQ
items.summary: AI-powered bookkeeping
items.content: LedgerIQ is an AI-powered financial assistant that automates bookkeeping so you can focus on growth. Scan receipts, invoices, and statements to extract transactions instantly. Automatically categorize income and expenses, generate P&L reports, and track cash flow. Use IQ Chat to ask questions like “What were my top expenses last month?” and get answers instantly.

items.title: Gymex Fitness — Train Smarter
items.summary: AI strength coach on iOS — free during launch
items.content: Gymex Fitness is an AI strength-training coach for iOS — conversational AI programming, voice-powered set logging, auto periodization, plateau detection, macro tracking, and Garmin integration. Currently free during launch.

items.title: Subzero
items.summary: Freeze the subscriptions you forgot you're paying for
items.content: Most people have 8+ subscriptions and forget half of them. I built Subzero after paying $340/year for forgotten apps. 🔍 Smart Scan — AI finds hidden charges in your bank statement ⏰ Smart Reminders — asked "Did you use this?" before every payment ❄ AI Cancel Guides — step-by-step instructions to cancel in minutes 📊 Insights — see exactly what you spend monthly and yearly Free plan available. Pro is $1.99/month.
